hero.title: Is COBRA Too Expensive? You Have Options.
hero.subtitle: COBRA lets you keep your exact employer plan — but you pay the full premium. For many people, there are significantly cheaper alternatives that still provide solid coverage.

Savings possible vs. COBRA with ACA subsidies

whenCobraSection.heading: When Does COBRA Actually Make Sense?
whenCobraSection.intro: COBRA isn't always the wrong choice — it's the right one in specific situations. Here's when it's worth the higher cost:

scenarios.title: You have ongoing treatment
scenarios.desc: If you're mid-treatment for cancer, surgery, or a chronic condition, staying on the same plan avoids disrupting your care team and coverage.

scenarios.title: You expect new coverage soon
scenarios.desc: Starting a new job in 1–2 months? COBRA bridges the gap without changing plans or providers.

scenarios.title: Your dependents have complex needs
scenarios.desc: If a spouse or child has a specialist they rely on, COBRA keeps that network intact.

scenarios.title: You've met your deductible
scenarios.desc: Late in the plan year and already hit your deductible? COBRA may be cheaper than starting over on a new plan.

alternativesSection.heading: Your Alternatives to COBRA
alternativesSection.intro: Each option has different trade-offs. Our advisors can help you choose the right fit.

alternatives.title: ACA Marketplace Plans
alternatives.subtitle: Healthcare.gov / State Exchange
alternatives.bestFor: Most people — especially those who qualify for premium tax credits

pros.text: Subsidies can make premiums very affordable
Losing job coverage triggers a Special Enrollment Period
Covers essential health benefits by law

cons.text: Network may differ from your previous employer plan
Must enroll within 60-day Special Enrollment Period

alternatives.title: Short-Term Health Insurance
alternatives.subtitle: Temporary Gap Coverage
alternatives.bestFor: Healthy individuals needing a bridge between jobs

pros.text: Can start as soon as tomorrow

alternatives.title: Hospital Indemnity Insurance
alternatives.subtitle: Fixed Benefit Cash Plans
alternatives.costNote: Pays fixed cash amounts per event
alternatives.bestFor: Supplementing other coverage or as a low-cost safety net

cons.text: Not a replacement for major medical coverage
Fixed benefit amounts may not cover full costs

alternatives.title: Accident-Only Plans
alternatives.subtitle: Accidental Injury Coverage
alternatives.bestFor: Active individuals who want protection from unexpected injuries

pros.text: Pairs well with other limited plans

cons.text: Does not cover illness or disease

alternatives.title: Teladoc / Virtual Care
alternatives.subtitle: Telehealth Membership
alternatives.bestFor: Healthy individuals who mainly need access to a doctor for minor issues

cons.text: No coverage for labs, imaging, or specialist visits
